outcome: differential metabolites in amniotic fluid supernatant
differential metabolites in amniotic fluid cells
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 28 fetuses from which amniotic fluid specimens were collected, including 18 with fetal growth restriction and 10 controls.
finding: The study identified significant differences in 27 metabolites in amniotic fluid supernatant and 20 metabolites in amniotic fluid cells between FGR and control groups, with key pathways involved including amino acid metabolism, TCA cycle, and ABC transport.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of amniotic fluid collection
